description: React component for displaying project links, modals, and related interactions in a certification context within the FreeCodeCamp project.

methods.name: handleSolutionModalHide
methods.description: Resets the solution state to initial values, hiding modals.

methods.name: getProjectSolution
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a project's solution or preview based on project ID and title.

methods.name: ProjectsFor
methods.description: Renders project links and solutions for a given certification slug.

methods.name: getCertHeading
methods.description: Returns the heading string key based on the certification type.
